given.note: On S1-10's secure page Sam types the one owner email for notices, sign-in help and answers by email (FS row B13, required; S1-10). The page's server side names whom the code is for from that page's own signed link, which Rosie made for Sam (forPersonId person-sam: K-22 v1 proof_codes.person_id and the account it goes on; K-21), never from the browser: on the helper path Pat's own link would name Pat, whose own sign-in it sets, and S1-77's link Sam (MASTER-FLOW-A line 182). The call keeps the address as a new email handle, the recipient of the code's email row, and as the owner email of Sam's account, not yet proven (K-22 v1 accounts.email), and sends an owner_email code there, to be typed back on the page; until then the email is used for nothing (S1-10: 'Until then it isn't used'). The call acts for no person until the code is right, so caller.personId is null (K-22 v1 rule 4). The code never comes back to the caller. The address is on the reserved .example domain.
